title: 天净沙·秋思
author: Ma Zhiyuan

translation: withered vines, an old tree, a crow at dusk
a small bridge, flowing water, a few homes
an ancient road, the west wind, a lean horse
the sun goes down in the west
a heartbroken man is at the end of the world

appreciation: Nine images are stacked without a verb, and the autumn landscape does all the speaking: dead vines, an old tree, a crow, a thin horse on an old road. The warm cottages by the bridge belong to other people, not to the traveller. The final line names the ache the whole picture has been building, making this the most famous short song of the Yuan dynasty.
